manyRobots.caption: Roken generates four-robot trajectories with four input robot tokens.

methodOverview.caption: Real-world deployment of one Roken model with 1, 2, 3, and 4 robots in unseen environments. The trajectories are generated in a feed-forward manner without any online optimization or iterative refinement.

variableTeams.caption: One Roken model scales to 2, 6, or 10 robots by changing the number of input robot tokens.

newScenarios.caption: Roken generates multi-robot trajectories with partially observed maps.
Roken generates multi-robot trajectories in our manually designed out-of-distribution maps.
